final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(c.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(rate) OVER () AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT status, total_scans, rate, rate - avg_rate AS diff_from_avg FROM a WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND rate > avg_rate
